versions.changelog: V2 remediation: add Example Prompts, Clean Scan Evidence, Install-First Success Path

Initial release of Home Filter Replacement Tracker  
- Track all household filters with locations, sizes/models, last changed dates, and replacement intervals  
- Build an organized replacement schedule, including 90-day and 12-month calendars  
- Generate a consolidated filter shopping list and reusable replacement log  
- Provide clear reminder checklists and flag items needing verification or professional help  
- Prioritize safety: never override manuals, landlord rules, or recommend unsafe maintenance
